nuestraEmpresa.title: Empaques Industriales ALPA
nuestraEmpresa.p1: Since its establishment in 1993 by Eng. Alfonso Antillón, our company has been dedicated to supplying wooden industrial packaging to meet the rigorous demands of industry in Monterrey.
nuestraEmpresa.p2: We specialize in processing both domestic and imported pine wood to manufacture products that respond directly to our clients' unique specifications. Our mission is to deliver solutions that optimize your resources while guaranteeing effective product protection, backed by impeccable service.
nuestraEmpresa.p3: With more than 30 years of market experience, we have perfected the production of high-quality wooden packaging. We continue to innovate and accept new challenges to grow alongside our clients and exceed expectations.

industries.problem: Pallet stockouts halting assembly line production
industries.solution: Vendor-managed inventory with scheduled deliveries. Never halt a line due to missing packaging again.

industries.problem: Product damage during freight and logistics
industries.solution: Custom-engineered pallets built for exact product dimensions, weight distributions, and transit stresses.

industries.problem: Standard packaging failing under heavy or irregular loads
industries.solution: Heavy-duty reinforced pallets and custom crates engineered for machinery, equipment, and structural materials.

industries.problem: Customs rejecting wooden packaging lacking fitosanitary seals
industries.solution: In-house heat treatment (HT) compliant with NOM-144-SEMARNAT-2017 / ISPM-15. Certified and stamped packaging.

conducta.title: Social Responsibility and Code of Conduct
conducta.text: Committed to conducting business in a responsible manner
conducta.p1: At ALPA, we are committed to an ethical, responsible, and sustainable operation. We hold a Social Responsibility Certification endorsing our commitment to corporate best practices, respect for our workforce, environmental care, and community responsibility.
conducta.p2: Furthermore, we operate under a certified Code of Conduct setting forth the core principles that govern our relationships with employees, clients, suppliers, and stakeholders.
conducta.commitmentTag: Our commitment is anchored in the principles of
principles: Respect for labor and human rights
Compliance with applicable laws and regulations
conducta.bottomText: These certifications represent more than recognition: they are an integral part of how we do business and our dedication to building trust and long-term relationships.
